3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Everyone was seated around a long table. They glanced around warily at each other, Manus, and the taxidermied animal heads looming above them.

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "You all know the real reason why we're here. Our citizens have long been demanding democracy. It is my duty as the monarch to ensure that transition."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "I know all of you have your own personal opinions and concerns about this. This is the time for you to speak your minds -- each and every one of you. So we can settle this once and for all."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "Very well. Let's begin. Shall we, Mr. Sazon?"

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "If we want our monarchy to survive this century -- we must adapt. Truly empowering the House of Delegates and leaving the government to the people is the only way for our monarchy to survive."

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "We have gathered here on this meaningful day to revolutionize our great kingdom and finally give the people of Rizia the right to rule themselves."

9.speaker: Rico Toras
9.text: "Your *duty*, Your Majesty? Let's not go overboard."

13.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
13.text: "Interesting. I had no idea that betraying the monarchy was one of the monarch's duties."

17.speaker: Rico Toras
17.text: "I will say right from the start that His Majesty's opinion does not reflect that of the rest of House Toras."

21.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
21.text: "I will say right from the start that I have my doubts about such a radical proposal."

22.speaker: Angelica Sazon
22.text: "The need for such a radical action is by no means evident, Your Majesty."

23.speaker: Manus Sazon
23.text: "The monarchy will stay in place, and the monarch will act as the head of state. But the true political power of the government shall belong to the people."

24.speaker: Hugo Toras
24.text: "We are ready to listen. But you must acknowledge that this is a tall request."
24.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Azaro_Supports"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Sazon_Supports"] == false) == false)

31.speaker: Manus Sazon
31.text: "We ask everyone at this table to cooperate and support the implementation of this constitution."

32.speaker: Rico Toras
32.text: "That's a lot to ask without offering us anything in return."
32.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Azaro_Supports"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Sazon_Supports"] == false) == false)

33.speaker: Angelica Sazon
33.text: "You are starting to sound like your father, Manus. To a dangerous degree."
33.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Sazon_Supports"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false)

34.speaker: Daria de Rava
34.text: "However, if the RPP and the royal houses can come to an agreement on this, we will not stand in their way."

35.speaker: Daria de Rava
35.text: "Having said that, as long as we can reach an agreement here today, the RNC is ready to work with the RPP on implementing the new constitution."

36.speaker: Leona Sazon
36.text: "I agree. I have supported you and the RPP for years, but your current tone worries me."

38.speaker: Manus Sazon
38.text: "We understand the concerns. That is the reason why I'm here today as a representative of the democratic movement. To show you that this movement is not against the monarchy."

40.speaker: Manus Sazon
40.text: "His Majesty already supports the constitution. And I know Princess Vina has been sympathetic to the cause in the past."

41.speaker: Manus Sazon
41.text: "So... I would like to give the floor to King Romus."

45.speaker: Lucita Azaro
45.text: "Mr. Sazon, you must admit that this is incredibly ill timing. Our focus should be on the war, not reform."

46.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
46.text: "I did not leave the frontlines just to listen to this populist drivel."

47.speaker: Angelica Sazon
47.text: "House Sazon will very gladly exercise that option."

48.speaker: Lucita Azaro
48.text: "House Azaro is happy to exercise that option."

55.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
55.text: "House Azaro is very happy to exercise that option."

60.speaker: Lucita Azaro
60.text: "Not to interrupt, Your Majesty, but is that *really* your duty?"

62.speaker: Manus Sazon
62.text: "Drafted by the Rizian People's Party, our renewed constitution represents the true will of Rizian citizens -- not only those born into wealth and power."

63.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
63.text: "All due respect, Your Majesty, but this amounts to nothing less than a coup against our country's nobility."
63.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Azaro_Supports"] == false)

64.speaker: Manus Sazon
64.text: "We are gathered here today because the Rizian people have made their demands clear. If Rizia is going to continue as a kingdom, it must first ensure its citizens' right to self-determination."

65.speaker: Manus Sazon
65.text: "We see no alternative but to adapt with the changing times. We already have a parliament and elections. Rizia is too vast and diverse to be dictated by a monarch or council of appointed nobles alone. And the fact is, His Majesty agrees."

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: Manus cleared his throat and started speaking loudly, as if he were stating his case before the House of Delegates.

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: I looked around the table before speaking.

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Mr. Sazon has said it all. We need to adapt. A single person cannot dictate the will of Rizia alone anymore."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "First of all, I must point out that we are not getting rid of the monarchy, nor the institutions that hold our kingdom together. I will transfer my legislative powers to the parliament and executive powers to the head of government, but I will remain the head of state."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "Please take a look at what's happening on the streets. People are discontent and they are organizing against our monarchy. The reality is clear as day."
75.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.BirthdayGathering_Protests_AllowedOnSquare"] == true) == false)

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Take a look at what's happening outside your estates. Millions are protesting and demanding democratic reforms. The reality is clear as day."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I acceded to the throne with the intention of reforming this country. The time for that transformation has finally come."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "When I took the throne, I had no intention of ceding any of my power. However, I am now convinced that I have a responsibility towards the Rizian people. And this transformation is necessary to adapt to the coming century."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "My father ignored the will of the people during his reign. His mistakes will not be repeated."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "We cannot ignore the unrest, nor can we silence every voice that is raised against us. My father's mistakes will not be repeated."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "I believe in incremental change, not radical transformation. These reforms are merely a continuation of what my father accomplished. All of you will be able to carry on much as before."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "I don't want to go down in history as another monarch who tried desperately to cling to power. It is my duty to ensure a smooth and peaceful transition."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "The government may change, but the monarchy and the great legacies of the noble houses will not. We will still be the cornerstones of our kingdom's stability."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "We must acknowledge that our system is inefficient. Absolute rule within the hands of a few cannot manage the intricacies of the 20th century."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "Our hands have been forced, and frankly, it's about time. As unfortunate it is, this is in the best interests of all of us."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "Just because we are born into nobility doesn't mean we are better suited to rule than anyone else. Rizia must slowly transform into a democracy."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "Let's be honest. We all would prefer to keep our massive wealth and our prestige as opposed to risking our heads trying to secure our political power, wouldn't we? Why even fight?"

112.text: "Let's be honest. Would you prefer to keep your heads and your accumulated wealth as a noble family, or would you rather lose both?"

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "Don't stand against change. Be a part of it. I am asking you as your King."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "If we join forces together, we can show the world our unity and resilience. We have a choice to make, and according to it, we will go down in history as heroes or villains."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "As the monarch, I will retain the final say over any legislation in order to protect the integrity of our kingdom."

1074.speaker: Player_Romus

1075.speaker: Player_Romus
1075.text: "I'd rather not budge an inch. But it seems the time has come for compromise."

1078.speaker: Player_Romus

1454.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.BirthdayGathering_Protests_AllowedOnSquare"] == true)

1458.speaker: Narrator
1458.text: As the string quartet outside finished a piece, the brief silence allowed us to hear the distant chanting and slogans from outside.

1459.speaker: Narrator
1459.text: Everyone around the table exchanged uneasy glances.

1461.speaker: Leona Sazon
1461.text: "What? Her party isn't even in the majority."

1462.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1462.text: "What? His party isn't even in the majority."

1465.speaker: Vina Toras
1465.text: "This is what our country needs to move forward."

1466.speaker: Vina Toras
1466.text: "As a Toras myself, and the heiress to the Rizian throne, I must say that I'm very supportive of the new constitution."

1467.speaker: Vina Toras
1467.text: "But I will warn you that the centralization measures as described may hinder the reconciliation process between Rizia and Pales. The Grand Duchy will not tolerate a complete loss of autonomy."

1471.speaker: Vina Toras
1471.text: "As the Duchess of Valenqiris, I do think this constitution should respect the autonomy of the provinces. Dismantling them will not help us."

1473.speaker: Narrator
1473.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Regions_Centralized"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Regions_Centralized"] == true) == false)

1475.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1475.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Legislative_HouseOfLords"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false

1476.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1476.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Legislative_HouseOfLords"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false) == false

1480.speaker: Narrator
1480.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Regions_Centralized"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Legislative_HouseOfLords"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Regions_Centralized"] == true) == false)

1481.speaker: Vina Toras
1481.text: "I do hope that the special privileges for the monarch and the nobility are removed one day. But I understand that Rizia is not ready for that yet."
1481.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Regions_Centralized"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Legislative_HouseOfLords"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Regions_Centralized"] == true) == false)

1482.speaker: Vina Toras
1482.text: "But if the others in House Toras are fine with the proposal as it is, I will not insist on rocking the boat."

1487.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1487.text: "I'm sorry, Manus. But the Sazons have ruled Brenas judiciously for over a century. I don't want our proud province to fall victim to mob rule."

1492.speaker: Narrator
1492.text: I saw Vina and Lucita lean forward in anticipation of my answer.

1500.speaker: Player_Romus
1500.text: "Your son is assuming the position of head of government, and he may well still become Prince Consort. Show some gratitude."

1501.speaker: Narrator
1501.text: I saw Lucita lean forward in anticipation of my answer.

1503.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1503.text: "She is more than fit for the throne. You and the Azaros cannot deprive her of her birthright like that."

1508.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1508.text: "She is more than fit for the throne. You and the Azaros cannot deprive her of her birthright like that."

1514.speaker: Player_Romus
1514.text: "Manus is already being appointed Prime Minister. He stands a chance at becoming Prince Consort. You are in no position to demand more than that."

1516.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1516.text: "I'm far from happy with the thought of my son and daughter-in-law being disinherited."

1518.speaker: Leona Sazon
1518.text: "I too believe this is the best decision -- for our family, and for Rizia."

1522.speaker: Leona Sazon
1522.text: "I cannot speak for House Sazon, Your Majesty. Only Angelica can."

1523.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1523.text: "Yes, Romus, I would be curious to know this as well."

1527.speaker: Narrator
1527.text: Vina was staring at me intensely.

1534.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1534.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_CityStateOfIza_LackOfOrder"] == false)

1544.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1544.text: "I admit he has shown surprising competence in the past years. It wouldn't be a bad decision."
1544.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_CityStateOfIza_LackOfOrder"] == false)) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true)

1545.speaker: Rico Toras
1545.text: "I know I was an idiot in my younger days. But look at how much I've accomplished in the last years."
1545.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_CityStateOfIza_LackOfOrder"] == false)) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false)

1549.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1549.text: "Up to a point. There are certain lines the RPP is not willing to cross."

1553.speaker: Manus Sazon
1553.text: "Still... we would not have invited you here if we didn't believe an amicable agreement could be reached."

1560.speaker: Narrator
1560.text: Vina gave a big smile of relief. I saw Lucita's eyes darken.
1560.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true)

1561.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1561.text: "Really, Romus? You don't even know where she is..."
1561.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true) == false)

1562.speaker: Player_Romus
1562.text: "Why does this even matter? If these reforms pass, the monarch will be a purely symbolic position."

1566.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
1566.text: "That's precisely why it matters. The monarch represents the very soul of Rizia."

1567.speaker: Hugo Toras
1567.text: "Indeed. One might argue that in the absence of ruling powers, the monarch's name and lineage will take on even greater importance going forward."

1571.speaker: Narrator
1571.text: Rico and Hubertus nodded their assent.

1576.speaker: Hugo Toras
1576.text: "Symbolic or not, we are talking about the continuation of centuries of Rizian tradition."

1577.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1577.text: "No matter their powers, whoever holds the throne represents the very heart and soul of Rizia. Are you truly going to deny your daughter that honor?"

1578.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1578.text: "The RPP is fine with this change."

1589.speaker: Player_Romus
1589.text: "Very well. I'm glad all three Houses are in agreement."

1595.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1595.text: "I'm sorry, Romus. It just wasn't the right time."

1599.speaker: Narrator
1599.text: I tried to catch Lucita's eye. She looked away.

1603.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1603.text: "You royals and your obsession with breeding... It's as if it were a pack of prize greyhounds leading the country."

1604.speaker: Narrator
1604.text: Adarfo fixed him with a bemused expression.

1608.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1608.text: "You royals and your obsession with breeding... It's as if it were a pack of prize greyhounds leading the country."

1609.speaker: Narrator
1609.text: Adarfo fixed her with a bemused expression.

1613.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1613.text: "You royals and your obsession with breeding... It's as if it were a pack of prize greyhounds leading the country."

1614.speaker: Narrator
1614.text: Adarfo fixed him with a bemused expression.

1615.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
1615.text: "You and His Majesty are asking us to swallow some very dramatic changes. I won't stand for the upending of tradition on top of all that."

1623.speaker: Narrator
1623.text: Vina let out an excited gasp.

1624.speaker: Narrator
1624.text: Adarfo took a slow glance around the room, his eyes finally coming to rest on me.

1628.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1628.text: "Let the history books show that you had a chance for peace. And that you rejected it out of your own selfish interests."

1629.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1629.text: "I knew this was never going to work your way."

1630.speaker: Narrator
1630.text: With a scowl, he stormed out the trophy room doors.

1634.speaker: Narrator
1634.text: A tear trickled down my daughter's face. Manus embraced her tightly.
1634.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

1638.speaker: Narrator
1638.text: My uncle made an effort to smile.

1639.speaker: Hugo Toras
1639.text: "We should rejoin your mother and the others. We still have a birthday to celebrate."

1643.speaker: Hugo Toras
1643.text: "You made an admirable effort, Romus. Your willingness to listen and compromise will serve you well in the next years of your reign."
1643.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Toras_Supports"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Toras_Supports"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == false)

1644.speaker: Hugo Toras
1644.text: "My instincts told me not to return to Porte Drazon. I should have listened to them..."
1644.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Toras_Supports"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Toras_Supports"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == false) == false)

1645.speaker: Narrator
1645.text: My uncle made an effort to turn his grimace into a smile.

1646.speaker: Narrator
1646.text: Hugo got to his feet with a smile.

1650.speaker: Hugo Toras
1650.text: "Congratulations to everyone in this room. It will take some time to get used to it, but I am looking forward to seeing what the future of Rizia holds."

1651.speaker: Hugo Toras
1651.text: "I suggest we return to the celebrations."

1652.speaker: Narrator
1652.text: Hugo stood and offered a strained smile. The disappointment in his eyes said more than words ever could.

1653.speaker: Hugo Toras
1653.text: "Congratulations to everyone in this room. House Toras knows better than to interfere with the course of history."

1654.speaker: Narrator
1654.text: Titus and his guards pushed the doors open for us.

1655.speaker: Narrator
1655.text: As we stepped back into the atrium, the nobles gathered there broke into polite applause.

1657.speaker: Player_Romus
1657.text: "You have made the right choice. The historians will write glowingly of this moment."

1658.speaker: Player_Romus
1658.text: "I look forward to reigning over our newly emancipated populace."

1662.speaker: Player_Romus
1662.text: "I'll miss your subservience. Just for old times' sake, I command you to applaud."

1665.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1665.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_TorasSigned"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_AzaroSigned"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_SazonSigned"] == false) == false

1666.speaker: Player_Romus
1666.text: "As for those of you who did not sign, your names and Houses will be remembered."

1667.speaker: Player_Romus
1667.text: "I knew that we could solve this without having to resort to violence."

1668.speaker: Manus Sazon
1668.text: "Yes, I thank you all for your willingness to cooperate."

1673.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1673.text: "We will move forward with the transition very soon."

1674.speaker: Manus Sazon
1674.text: "We could never have done this without you, Your Majesty."

1678.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1678.text: "Not true. But your cooperation and that of the other nobles definitely made things easier."

1683.speaker: Manus Sazon
1683.text: "Yes... we have truly come a long way since the 1920s."

1684.speaker: Narrator
1684.text: Everyone around the table applauded with a burst of nervous laughter.

1685.speaker: Manus Sazon
1685.text: "His Majesty means to say that the reforms will benefit everyone. You will come to see their value in the end."

1686.speaker: Narrator
1686.text: Adarfo had a thin-lipped smile on his face.

1692.speaker: Manus Sazon
1692.text: "The RPP will present the reform proposal in the House of Delegates soon. I promise you will all come to see the good in these changes."

1693.speaker: Narrator
1693.text: Manus and Vina exchanged looks of trepidation.

1697.speaker: Narrator
1697.text: He looked at me in trepidation.

1698.speaker: Player_Romus
1698.text: "Thank you nonetheless for joining me here."

1699.speaker: Player_Romus
1699.text: "None of you had better even think about trying to stop me. There will be consequences."

1700.speaker: Player_Romus
1700.text: "Now let's get back out there and celebrate the Queen Mother's birthday, shall we?"

1702.speaker: Narrator
1702.text: My fellow nobles bowed as they left the room -- some with genuine deference, others with an air of defiance.

1706.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1706.text: "I will still support you. Even if nobody else does."

1707.speaker: Narrator
1707.text: When almost everyone had left, Lucita came up to me and shook her head in disappointment.
1707.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Azaro_Supports"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Son_RespectTradition"] == true) == false)

1708.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1708.text: "I understand why you did what you did. But there must have been a better way."

1709.speaker: Narrator
1709.text: She rushed past me and back into the library.

1710.speaker: Narrator
1710.text: I felt myself fill with resolve.

1711.speaker: Narrator
1711.text: I would see these reforms through. No matter what.

1712.speaker: Player_Romus
1712.text: "You will regret this. All of you."

1713.speaker: Player_Romus
1713.text: "I thank you all nonetheless for joining me here today."

1714.speaker: Player_Romus
1714.text: "The voice of the Rizian people will not be silenced. This is not over."

1715.speaker: Player_Romus
1715.text: "I won't hold any of you individually responsible for this. We can just carry on as if nothing happened."

1716.speaker: Narrator
1716.text: My fellow nobles bowed as they left the room -- some with genuine deference, others with an air of defiance.

1717.speaker: Narrator
1717.text: As I headed back out into the library, I felt the full weight of the crown on my head.

1718.speaker: Narrator
1718.text: For now, it was still mine to bear.

1723.speaker: Narrator
1723.text: I locked eyes with Titus and gave him the smallest of nods. Understanding, he moved with practiced silence, positioning himself by the door.

1730.speaker: Narrator
1730.text: I locked eyes with one of Adarfo's men, who was disguised as a server, and gave him the smallest of nods.

1739.speaker: Narrator
1739.text: I heard the doors click shut.

1751.text: "Vina, would you be so kind as to return to the main hall and check on your grandmother? There's a private matter with the other nobles I wish to address." [Proceed with House strike]

1752.speaker: Vina Toras
1752.text: "I don't understand. Shouldn't I be here too?"

1753.speaker: Player_Romus
1753.text: "This isn’t a debate. Do as you’re told."

1754.speaker: Player_Romus
1754.text: "This isn’t about excluding you. It’s about doing what’s best for everyone. Please go."

1755.speaker: Player_Romus
1755.text: "You belong here, Vina, but not for this."

1757.speaker: Narrator
1757.text: She shot me a disappointed glare as she stood up and left.

1758.speaker: Narrator
1758.text: She managed a faint smile and left without complaint, though her disappointment was evident.

1759.speaker: Player_Romus
1759.text: "Each and every one of you *will* support the new constitution. I am giving you no choice." [Give the signal]

1760.speaker: Player_Romus
1760.text: "Your resistance is noble, but you're going endorse these reforms, whether you like it or not. Disobedience is not an option."

1763.speaker: Narrator
1763.text: I turned my attention back to the others.

1764.speaker: Player_Romus
1764.text: "Make no mistake -- each one of you *will* bow to the new constitution. Failure to comply will be met with severe consequences."

1768.speaker: Player_Romus
1768.text: "Each and every one of you *will* support the new constitution. I am giving you no choice."

1773.speaker: Narrator
1773.text: Before she could speak, we heard the doors click shut.
